segs.text: A humanoid robot just sank seven bean bags in a row. Its teacher? One video of a person playing.

segs.text: Google just released Gemini 4 Argon, its newest frontier AI model.

segs.text: In an internal test, Argon watched a person play cornhole, mapped the scene, and wrote its own physics simulation to practise in.

segs.text: Then the skill moved onto a real humanoid, Apptronik's Apollo. After a few warm-up throws: seven straight shots.

segs.text: Google says that turns weeks of simulation work into hours.

segs.text: The catch: it's Google's own demo of one simple game, not an independent test.
